# Leave one development person out (generated by scripts/loso.py) - exploratory

Each development person is tested with models trained on the other 15 (U-Net: 2 epochs, 3 seeds; average-beat baseline fitted and tuned on the same 15). Test data: the person's 'late' part.

## Means over the 16 development people

| method   |     r |   beat_se |   beat_ppv |   r_timing_abs_ms |   template_r |   beat_r |   r_amp_ratio |
|:---------|------:|----------:|-----------:|------------------:|-------------:|---------:|--------------:|
| avg_beat | 0.413 |      0.97 |      0.962 |            22.875 |        0.499 |    0.428 |         0.997 |
| unet     | 0.646 |      0.98 |      0.953 |            11.875 |        0.685 |    0.645 |         1.051 |

- unet vs avg_beat: unet better for 14 of 16 people; mean r difference +0.233; Wilcoxon p = 0.00101
